title: She made him jealous with ONE dumpling pic
caption:
Never text your friend a food pic. Trust me.
She lifts a steaming dumpling, photographs the full bamboo steamer, and sends it straight to Luo Chen - who instantly drools into a tissue.
Real friendship is making each other hungry on purpose, and already planning the next food adventure.
Be honest: are you the one sending the pic or the one drooling?
Share this with the friend you'd drag to dim sum.
#relatable #animatedshort #storytime #friendshipgoals #fruit_drama_tv
